## What the W4 evidence actually says (folded, never inferred)

| arm | settled | rc | scored outcome | disposition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| mini-swe-agent | 50/50 | 50×rc=0 | **29 pass / 21 fail** (`collect/reward.txt` per slot, each cited by sha256) | executed — landed reference for P2-FP |
| hh_native | 50/50 | 46×rc=0 + **4×rc=1** | none — all 50 verifier execs recorded failures (49×test.sh absent rc=127, 1×container-improper rc=255) | `unavailable{verifier_recorded_no_verdict}` — the 4 rc=1 are recorded failures, never withholds |
| v5 | 20/50 | 20×rc=1 | none — `verifier_unavailable{env_closed_or_unmounted}` | 20 settled + 30 `dropped{makespan_checkpoint:w4-round-2}` (derived ids committed) |
| pi | 0 | — | — | `not_run{admission:AG3}` verbatim |
| claude-code | 0 | — | — | `not_run{admission:AG3}` verbatim |

The earlier "50/50 rc=0" reading of mini-swe-agent reconciles trivially:
`rc` is process completion; the verifier *reward* is the score —
29/50 pass is the honest fold, and it is what the packets carry.

## Claim dispositions (landed vs withheld/not-run/inconclusive)

- **P2-FP** — packet `not_run{admission:AG3}`: mini-swe-agent **landed**
  (`executed` — the pre-registered reference: theta_fm hi 409,978 ppm,
  FM interval [250,184, 409,978] ppm over the vetoed fold —
  unreviewed flagged passes score as failures per the joint-population
  rule); pi + claude-code stay `not_run{admission:AG3}` members at
  equal prominence, Δ family members `unavailable`.
- **P4-FP** — packet `unavailable{no_scored_outcome}`: hh_native
  executed all 50 slots (failures recorded as failures) but every
  verifier exec produced no verdict; v5 settled 20
  verifier-unavailable + dropped 30 at the round-2 checkpoint. The
  Δ(v5−hh_native) contrast is honestly unavailable — no score inferred
  from rc.
- **P3-L2** — `unavailable{h_side_verdicts_absent}`: 50 pairs launched
  coupled; L1 gate pass carries over (GL-1 pin); parity admission,
  TOST conjunction and veto check all typed unavailable.
- **L1-on-L2 audit** — `not_computed{o_recording_replay_not_executed}`:
  population = the 50 W4-O recordings (never W2-corpus ids), seeded
  sample of 5 committed for byte-identical re-derivation; the L1.1
  obs_replay leg was not wired in this ticket — recorded, not
  fabricated.
- **L3** — descriptive only: per-arm distributions land (hh_native
  steps/tool_calls/errors/wall_ms; mini-swe-agent same + wall_ms),
  discordance `not_applicable{h_side_verdicts_absent}`, all 50 pairs
  class `uncertain{h_side_verdict_absent}`.

## Site / publication — deliberately unchanged this round

The site input set points at `*-frozen` records; the freeze refuses
while flags are unreviewed, so no new site-facing record exists and
**no `hh-site-publication/1` supersession was emitted** — minting one
over unreviewed flags would leak the exact state REQ-XH-121 exists to
gate. On HUMAN-H19's dispositions landing: `fp_w4_results freeze`
mints the five frozen copies, the P2-FP phase-3 page changes
(pi/cc unavailable, mini landed), the superseding publication records
emit citing this W4 window digest + ADR-0452 + the prior records'
supersession chain, and `scripts/site/build.py --emit` +
`check-site.sh --profile internal|public` run. Deferred by design,
not skipped — the path is `fp_w4_results freeze && emit-packets`-ready.

## Implementation

- `crates/hh-runner/src/fp_w4.rs` — the evidence-aware fold:
  `hh-fp-w4-outcomes/1` record, `planned_population` via
  `population::assemble` (one counting rule — unscored settled slots
  resolve `OracleFailure`/`Unavailable`, never coerced), landed +
  typed arm rows, the five superseding packets, `hh-flagged-review-input/1`,
  `w4_freeze_packet` (the REQ-XH-121 veto), `validate_w4_results_packet`.
- `crates/hh-runner/src/bin/fp_w4_results.rs` — `emit` (retained fold
  → all 8 records), `emit-packets` (committed-inputs packets only,
  byte-stable anywhere), `freeze` (refuses loudly on unreviewed flags).
  Read-side note: the retained mini-swe-agent trajectories are
  provider-format floats; `parse_provider` folds non-integral lexemes
  to Str verbatim — never a coercion, and only `role`/`extra.actions`
  members are read. The committed window's integral-float
  `dead_man_epoch` projects to its integer value at read time; the
  committed bytes are untouched.
- `crates/hh-runner/src/fp_results.rs` — `family_row` is now `pub`
  (shared row shape; R6.48 behavior byte-identical — r6_48 battery
  green).
- `scripts/fp-w4-results-inputs.txt` — the manifest (same
  `name=relpath` idiom).
- `crates/hh-runner/tests/r6_53.rs` — 9-test regression battery.
- `scripts/check-fp-w4-results.sh` — 25-leg recompute check.
